answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the system anchors each identity to a cryptographic kernel enforcing superlinear stake burning. To register n clones, an attacker faces quadratic cost scaling C(n) = k * n^2, turning any defensive knoll into an insurmountable economic barrier. A verifiable burn beacon acts as a lantern exposing unbacked replicas, making mass forgery exponentially unprofitable through rigorous friction.
